import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(eps)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]*T**3+p[4]*T**4) + (p[5]+p[6]*T)*L + p[7]/eps + p[8]*eps + p[9]*L/eps
